memory_comparison.explanation: Memory ON retrieves the stored hall so later files are merged into prior people. Memory OFF rebuilds only from the supplied file, so it cannot follow the Open Day waitlist or earlier cancellations. Mixed results would mean Groq fallback still counted seats correctly but lost history.
